title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security on Jurisdiction Issues Concerning Certain Categories of Cases under Two Supplementary Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
keywords_en: corruption; smuggling; several types of cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security

Notice Concerning Jurisdiction over Certain Types of Cases Under Two Supplementary Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

[88] Gao Jian Hui (Yan) Zi No. 17

To the High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government:

Pursuant to the Supplementary Provisions Concerning the Punishment of Smuggling Crimes and the Supplementary Provisions Concerning the Punishment of Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery enacted by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, we hereby notify the following regarding the jurisdiction over certain types of cases:

1. Cases of evasion of foreign exchange and illegal arbitrage of foreign exchange shall be placed on file for investigation by the public security organs.

2. Cases of misappropriation of public funds, cases of holding a huge amount of property with unidentified sources, and cases of concealing overseas deposits and failing to report them shall be placed on file for investigation by the people's procuratorates.

October 22, 1988
